name: TIP31C
description: Medium-power NPN in TO-220, 100V/3A. The C suffix is the 100V grade. Standard JEDEC TO-220 B-C-E pinout, tab tied to collector. Complement to the TIP32C.

pins.name: C
pins.description: collector (tied to the metal mounting tab)

TO-220.notes: printed face toward you, tab at back, leads down: B-C-E. Tab = collector (live).

typical_application: Audio output/driver stages, motor and relay drivers, linear regulators, general power switching to 3A/100V; often the output device of a Darlington pair with a small-signal driver.
gotchas: collector is common with the mounting tab; use an insulating pad when bolting to a grounded or shared heatsink
low Vebo of 5V; reverse base-emitter voltage above 5V damages it (push-pull / fast turn-off circuits)
modest beta (as low as 10 at 3A); drive the base hard enough
only the C grade is 100V; do not assume a bare TIP31 has the C rating
